extDescription.message: A small local AI tidies your bookmarks into clear folders, with emoji and icon-only bar items. Private, offline, free.

startLead.message: A small AI on this computer recreates all your bookmarks in clear folders. You check, then you confirm.

optHistory.message: Put the most visited sites first

optHistoryHint.message: Counts the visits of each site and reads the titles already stored, on this computer. Nothing is sent.

optIconOnlyHint.message: Proposed by default; names can be shown again

reviewHint.message: Tested, not enough clues. Open them to check, then pick a suggestion or drag them onto a folder. Otherwise they go to “To check”, in Other bookmarks.

doneSkipped.message: {1} items skipped because they changed meanwhile. Nothing is lost: the originals are in the backup.

undoSkipped.message: {1} items were left as you changed them.

changedBanner.message: Your bookmarks changed in the browser during the review.

errorModel.message: The model could not be loaded. If you built the extension yourself, run “pnpm fetch-model” then build again.

emptyHint.message: No bookmarks in the chosen folders. Choose other folders.

reasonHomeService.message: Service hosted at home (local address or personal domain)

reviewVague.message: Generic title and uninformative address: impossible to know what the page contains.

lang.description: Language of this message file, used for folder names.

interruptedHint.message: The browser closed while changes were being applied. Undo what was done, or keep it as it is.

errorUnresolved.message: The last sort was interrupted. Undo it or keep it before organizing again.

changedBlocked.message: Refresh the proposal first: your bookmarks changed.

emptyFolder.message: Empty. Drag bookmarks onto this folder in the diagram.

iconOnlyHint.message: Click to show the icon only

footerSync.message: Changes also apply to your other signed-in devices.

barHint.message: Click a bookmark to hide or show its name

barScopeHint.message: Shortcuts included: the most used come back first

optReadSites.message: Read sites when the title is not enough

optReadSitesHint.message: Slower, more accurate. Chrome asks once for access to sites.

optCheckDead.message: Find sites that no longer answer

optCheckDeadHint.message: They are set apart, in “Unreachable sites”.

privacyBody.message: The AI runs here, with no account and no server. To understand a site, Nidomark opens its page like your browser, without cookies, and sends nothing else.

sitesNote.message: Several sites at a time. Nothing is sent, pages are only read.

sitesAsked.message: Chrome will ask for access to sites at the next analysis

backupConfirm.message: “{1}” and everything in it will be deleted for good. Your filed bookmarks do not move, but the sort that created it can no longer be undone.

clearCacheHint.message: The cache speeds up the next analyses; it stays on this computer.

reasonKeptFolder.message: Your folder “{1}”, recreated as it is

deadNetwork.message: No longer answers: site not found

reviewUnclear.message: No clear theme in the title and address

reviewBlocked.message: The site refuses to be read ({1})

reviewNoAccess.message: Vague title; allow reading sites to learn more

nodeDupesMeta.message: Not recreated, kept in the backup

dupesHint.message: These pages already exist elsewhere: one copy is recreated. These ones stay in the backup.

optDupesHint.message: Duplicates are not recreated; they stay in the backup.

reviewHintUntested.message: Not enough clues. “Analyze again” tests their sites; you can also open them to check. Otherwise they go to “To check”.

archiveNote.message: Your current tree is kept as it is in a dated backup, in Other bookmarks. One click undoes the sort.

barSheetHint.message: The sites you open most, as icons at the start of the bar. In the preview, click an icon to show its name.

doneArchive.message: Your previous tree is in “{1}”, in Other bookmarks.

nodeBarMeta.message: Icons at the start of the bar

optQuickAccessHint.message: The most visited sites, as icons at the start of the bar

reasonFacet.message: {1} bookmarks from the same site or on the same subject

reasonMyFolders.message: Your folders that mix several subjects

reasonQuickAccess.message: One of the sites you open most

reasonReviewFolder.message: Not enough clues to file them

reasonSpecial.message: A link that is not a web page (bookmarklet, browser page, file)

leaveBody.message: Your bookmarks have not been changed. To sort them, you will run the analysis again.

deleteKeepHint.message: Its bookmarks and subfolders move up into “{1}”.

deleteWithContentHint.message: Its bookmarks are not recreated: they stay in the backup.

folderDeleted.message: “{1}” deleted: what it held moved up

looseHint.message: Bookmarks right in {1}, outside any folder.

nodeRemovedMeta.message: Not recreated, kept in the backup

reanalyzedNothing.message: Nothing to analyze again in “{1}”: you placed its bookmarks yourself.

removedHint.message: These bookmarks are not recreated. They stay in the backup: restore them here, or drag them onto a folder.

removedOne.message: “{1}” will not be recreated (it stays in the backup)

removedCount.message: Not recreated: {1} (they stay in the backup)

existingFolderHint.message: A folder of an earlier sort: new bookmarks are added to it, and it keeps its name and place.
